title: openraft as the Raft implementation
context: TASK-0003 recommended raft-rs; TASK-0004 found raft-rs 0.7.0 fails the advisory gate (protobuf 2.28 RUSTSEC-2024-0437, fxhash RUSTSEC-2025-0057) and does not build with current protoc. DS-CORE runs many Raft groups per store and must fsync before ack (REQ-0016).
decision: Use openraft 0.9 (stable line) with the storage-v2 API. The RocksDB log store signals append completion only after the store-wide fsync, so a node counts toward a quorum only for entries it has made durable; appends from many groups share one synced WriteBatch. Joint consensus and learners come from openraft's membership API. Revisit when openraft 0.10 is stable.
